posts.text: The time to do something is now, and we must act.

Happy Arab American Heritage Month!

To the Arab American community in CA-36 and across the country—thank you for your culture, contributions, and the many ways you make our communities stronger.

Today, the Artemis II crew will fly farther than any human has before.

This is what investing in science and innovation can do.

Under the Trump administration, average custody times for CHILDREN increased from 37 to 200 days.

This is unjust and inhumane.


ABC News (@ABC)

An immigrant family is grappling with the ordeal suffered by a 3-year-old girl who endured alleged sexual abuse while her father fought for five months for her release from federal custody.

This National Public Health Week, the health of our country is under attack.

Hundreds of hospitals are at risk of closure. Millions are losing health insurance. Families are being forced to choose between essential care and putting food on the table.

We need to invest in America’s health—not gut programs that keep us safe.
